Chapter 844: Chapter 34: Breakthrough (Please Subscribe)_2

In addition, his mental will strength has also entered the twelfth level.

Having reached the twelfth level in both aspects, Lin Yuan believed he could attempt the Seventh Layer.

“The Seventh Layer?”

The humanoid Statue Shen Ji fell silent again, then stepped aside and watched Lin Yuan enter the nine-layered Black Tower.

Less than half an hour later.

Lin Yuan withdrew from the Seventh Layer.

“It’s still not feasible.”

Lin Yuan’s eyebrows were tightly furrowed; to pass through the Seventh Layer of the Black Tower, if one is a twelfth-level powerhouse, a peak understanding of the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm is required.

If not at the twelfth level, at least reaching the Seventh Realm in the Space-Time Fusion Rule domain is necessary to have a chance.

After all, although Lin Yuan’s time-space comprehension and mental will reached the twelfth level, he ultimately was not a twelfth-level powerhouse. The requirements to pass through the Seventh Layer would definitely be higher than for a normal twelfth-level powerhouse.

“Completed two-thirds of the journey?”

The nearby Statue Shen Ji remained silent.

Although Lin Yuan ultimately did not pass the Seventh Layer, he had completed two-thirds of it, which was an inconceivable feat.

A mere tenth-level being completed two-thirds of the journey through the Seventh Layer, only achievable by a Supreme Being?

What kind of freak is he?

Thinking of Lin Yuan becoming a member of the Demon Jade Tower on the tenth level, Statue Shen Ji barely managed to calm his spirit.

“Mental will and Space-Time Fusion Rule comprehension both completely entered the twelfth level, especially the strength of mental will…”

Statue Shen Ji reminisced about Lin Yuan’s attempts at the Seventh Layer, feeling waves of emotions rising in his heart again.

Thus far, the talent and aptitude displayed by Lin Yuan, even in his youth, far surpassed that of the Demonic Jade Tower Master.

Not just surpassed.

But far surpassed.

The Demonic Jade Tower Master had many miraculous encounters in his youth and had reached the twelfth level realm prematurely in certain aspects.

But at that time, the Demonic Jade Tower Master was already at the eleventh level.

But now, Lin Yuan is only at the tenth level?

Between the tenth and eleventh levels, though seemingly only a step apart, it’s like a chasm.

“What a pity.” Lin Yuan took one last look at the majestic nine-layered Black Tower and sighed.

“Still a pity…” Statue Shen Ji’s lips twitched slightly; at the tenth level, he didn’t pass the Seventh Layer and still found it a pity?

“Then I will take my leave.”

Lin Yuan bid farewell to the humanoid Statue Shen Ji, and his figure disappeared into the Demon Jade Space.

Suddenly, in the vast Demon Jade Space, only the solitary Statue Shen Ji stood before the nine-layered Black Tower.

“Master, with your means, did you ever expect that the Demon Jade Tower could now give birth to a member of its sequence?” Statue Shen Ji murmured to himself for a while before falling back into slumber.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“First cultivate the ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ to the perfect level.” Lin Yuan quickly took out numerous resources.

Having adjusted his condition earlier, Lin Yuan had purchased a vast amount of resources, preparing to step into the eleventh level and to cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’.

Having now obtained the ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ at the tenth level, he naturally planned to first cultivate this body-refining method to completion.

When stepping into the eleventh level, inducing the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, the stronger the physical and Soul Body’s internal world, the more Chaos Void Origin it can withstand, and the greater the benefits to oneself.

Originally, Lin Yuan’s physical body had already reached its peak; at the tenth level, no amount of resources, methods, or secret techniques could improve it even slightly.

But the ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ still allowed his physical strength to continue improving, an opportunity Lin Yuan naturally grasped.

Since ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ Lin Yuan had already reached a perfect state, with sufficient resources, cultivating it to perfect level wouldn’t take long.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, six months had passed.

“Finally reached the tenth level perfect.”

Lin Yuan felt deep within his body, his flesh like black crystal jade, with Xuanhuang-colored light flowing, terrifying blood energy shaking the multiple Spatial Layers.

“Everything is ready.”

Lin Yuan glanced around, the Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit had also arrived early.

As for the originally large battlefield? Lin Yuan had long since placed an avatar there.

Before his tenth traverse, Lin Yuan’s mental will was just at a normal standard, and the large Battlefield of Different Races was full of dangers, requiring the Primordial Spirit to oversee to ensure the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force over the long term.

As for the avatar? The avatar was too weak, utterly incapable of handling the pressures on a large Battlefield of Different Races.

But after the tenth traversal, Lin Yuan’s mental will had significantly improved, causing his avatar’s combat power to also be maintained at the Level Eleven tier.

Even though it’s still not comparable to the two Primordial Spirits, it’s more than enough to handle the dangers of a large Battlefield of Different Races.

For the most part, battles at the Level Eleven tier would not erupt in a large Battlefield of Different Races.

“It’s time to contact the Supreme Beings.” Lin Yuan connected to the Virtual World and spoke to Xia Qin, the Supreme Being. He then stepped forward, leaving the Milky Way Main Star and heading deep into a Spatial Layer of a location in the Galaxy Master’s territory.

Breaking through to Level Eleven would trigger the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, naturally, he couldn’t break through on the main star, as the impact would be too significant. Even a slight disturbance would turn the Milky Way Main Star to dust.

…

While Lin Yuan was sitting in the depths of the Spatial Layer, making final adjustments.

In the Milky Way Star Region, incarnations of humanity’s Supreme Beings descended one after the other.

Xia Qin, the Supreme Being.

Yudie, the Supreme Being.

Ancient Power, the Supreme Being.

Void God, the Supreme Being.

And so on, all nine Supreme Beings’ shadowy incarnations appeared.

Even the true body of Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, was paying attention to this place.

By using his incarnation as a beacon, the true body of Xia Qin could arrive at any time.

“He’s finally starting the breakthrough.” Xia Qin appeared slightly exhilarated, more nervous than Lin Yuan himself, having waited for months for Lin Yuan’s news.

“I’ve set up Space-Time Domains in dozens of nearby Star Domains.”

The Void God Supreme Being spoke; his mastery in the spatial aspect was profound, relating essentially to the Space Great Tao.

With the Void God Supreme Being’s application of space, the Space-Time Domains he set up were impenetrable even to a group of Supreme Beings in a short time.

“For this young one’s breakthrough, we’ve all spent quite some effort.”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being couldn’t help but speak up. In the history of human civilization, except for those at Level Eleven who are striving for the ultimate, they had never paid such close attention.

However, given Lin Yuan’s displayed talent and aptitude, it was worth it for the nine Supreme Beings to do so.

Whether it’s perceiving the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at Level Ten or his mental will stepping into the realm of Supreme Beings.

These were unprecedented in human civilization.

In the eyes of the nine Supreme Beings, Lin Yuan’s assault on Level Eleven was even more critical than those Level Eleven Evolutionaries striving for the ultimate.

“When he broke through to Level Ten, I wasn’t present. Now I can see what kind of stir this young one will cause.”

Another human Supreme Being said enthusiastically.

When Lin Yuan broke through to Level Ten, it caused a Chaos Void Origin Infusion, although not as significant as the assault, it was still unprecedented.

Those Supreme Beings who missed it felt quite regretful.

“It should be quite the spectacle.”

Xia Qin guessed: “Perhaps close to challenging the ultimate?”

When Lin Yuan reached Level Ten, he perceived the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, greatly enhancing his internal world, coupled with the transformation of his physical and soul bodies, the Chaos Void Origin handled would definitely far exceed those from Level Nine breaking through to Level Ten.

“Close to the spectacle of challenging the ultimate?”

The remaining few human Supreme Beings glanced at each other.

Could it be that Lin Yuan already possesses a basis for a perfect Level Eleven? How is that possible?

“Let’s watch.”

Yudie, the Supreme Being, spoke.

…

Deep in the Spatial Layer.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his two Primordial Spirits had long since returned inside his body.

From being historically tangible to now vague, the internal worlds of the two Primordial Spirits did not shrink to millions of miles in radius, but still maintained a size of 2.3 billion miles, with the effects of the mysterious gourd still in place.

Time slowly passed.

“Beginning the breakthrough.”

Lin Yuan’s inner Qi was perfected to his liking, while he simultaneously released the suppression on himself.

Without suppression, he would have crossed into Level Eleven the moment he perceived some kind of Pillar-level Fusion Rule at the Second Layer.

As Lin Yuan completely released himself.

His life essence quickly leaped toward Level Eleven.

The world’s void suddenly fell into silence.

Then—

Boom!!!
